■ Whenever any of your creatures attacks, you may put a creature from your opponent's graveyard on top of their deck. If you do, choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone. That creature gets -3000 power until the end of the turn. (A creature that has power 0 or less is destroyed.)
Double Breaker
